rachel (People Ops): Quick question 0min read: we need a comp-band exception for a contractor->FTE conversion (Elena Ruiz). Hiring wants base above band + an early-equity tranche. Routing suggestions?

mike (Recruiter): Candidate's a high-performer; been on contract ID 5543 for 8 months. Proposed full-time: base $117,000, sign-on $8k one-time, first-year equity grant 0.12% with first tranche vesting at 3 months (accelerated). L4 band cap is $110k, and standard equity cadence is 12 months cliff. Candidate and manager want April 1 start.

tanvi (Hiring Manager): This role owns infra reliability. If we don't convert quickly we risk losing them. I'm asking exec-comp to consider the accelerated vest and modest base lift. Can we tag as "conversion exception"? :wave:

jordan (Finance): Need run-rate & one-time calc + cost center. Quick sketch:```
base = 117000
benefits_est = base * 0.22
one_time_cash = 8000
est_1yr_cost = base + benefits_est + one_time_cash
```

jordan (Finance): From quick math est_1yr_cost ~= $143k. We need headcount slot confirmed and GL mapping for the sign-on/one-time. If recruiting covers the vendor offboarding invoice, that helps.

cleo (Legal): Two legal notes: 1) contractor offboarding must include confirmation of IP/NDAs and any transition statement from vendor 2) accelerated equity tranche requires exec-comp sign-off and must be documented in the offer paperwork. Also verify immigration/work-authorization if applicable (Elena is US-based).

rachel (People Ops): Routing plan: open approval ticket to exec-comp, include offer doc, vendor offboard note, finance calc, and proposed equity amendment. Ask for 72hr review (we've seen exec-comp move slower, so allow 3 days). I can draft the memo.

mike (Recruiter): Uploaded offer draft to /files/ElenaR-offer-DFT.pdf and vendor offboard confirmation at https://docs.internal/5543-offboard. Candidate can start Apr 1 but vendor needs final week to process payroll cutoff (last contractor payday Mar 15).

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-4829. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal. SLA: 72 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-4829

jordan (Finance): I'll provisionally approve the one-time if recruiting confirms GL strings. Please add cost-center: ENG-CORE-42 and attach the headcount approval doc.

tanvi (Hiring Manager): I'll add a short note on business impact to the ticket. Happy to jump on a 10-min sync with exec-comp if they want color.

rachel (People Ops): Good. If exec-comp approves, we'll: 1) mark start date "pending vendor offboard" 2) include accelerated-tranche language conditional on sign date 3) set payroll conversion date to first full payroll after vendor finalization.

mike (Recruiter): Noted. I'll message Elena that start is tentatively Apr 1 pending approvals and final vendor cutoff.

(tanvi) :thumbsup: (jordan) :thumbsup: (cleo) :eyes:
